description: Convert the Product Feature Progress and configuration templates into natural English canonical rendering sources. Template instructions must require agents to render human-readable headings and guidance in document_language without translating machine fields.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical Product module Feature detail and Progress templates contain natural English source text
Rendering instructions preserve every required section when document_language is not English
JSON keys enum values IDs paths and evidence strings remain unchanged across document languages
Template JSON files continue to pass repository validation
notes: Human review confirmed all acceptance criteria on 2026-08-26. Product, Product module, Feature detail, and Progress templates now use natural English canonical source text. methodology/templates/README.md defines one language-aware rendering contract: preserve every required section and its semantics, render human-readable content in document_language, and keep JSON keys, enums, IDs, paths, placeholder prefixes, review severities, and evidence strings stable. No localized template tree or runtime localization framework was introduced. Fresh-context review found one incomplete required-section test inventory; commit f3776a5 made it exhaustive and the reviewer confirmed no remaining must_fix findings. Code smell scan: pass (feature: F011, must_fix: 0, suggest: 0, acceptable: 3).
